purpose: Authoritative base products for the built-in Mars preset; renderer artifacts are derivatives, not replacements for their scientific sources.

referenceFrame.name: IAU_MARS
referenceFrame.authority: IAU WGCCRE 2015 constants distributed by NASA NAIF in pck00011.tpc

orbitalElements.frame: mean ecliptic and equinox of J2000
orbitalElements.applicationNote: KnowThing records orientation but does not apply the J2000 mean anomaly to its fictional-calendar day zero. The preset therefore keeps its deterministic local epoch phase instead of claiming ephemeris alignment.

products.title: Mars Viking Colorized Global Mosaic (MDIM 2.1)
products.license: Public domain; no use constraints stated by USGS
products.meaning: A cartographically controlled, colorized Viking image mosaic for global appearance. It is not a calibrated intrinsic reflectance field.

runtime.derivation: Lanczos resample of the USGS 1 km ancillary JPEG to a 4096 x 2048 sRGB plate; no relighting or generated detail.

products.title: MGS MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Record, median topography, 16 pixels/degree
products.meaning: Median topography in metres: planetary radius minus the GMM3 (mgm1025) areoid evaluated to degree and order 50. Empty bins are interpolated by the source product.

runtime.derivation: The signed big-endian PDS3 samples were longitude-rolled from 0..360 east to -180..180, linearly encoded, then Lanczos-resampled to 4096 x 2048.

products.title: Mars MGS TES Global Bolometric Albedo Map
products.meaning: Measured Lambert bolometric albedo from TES visible/near-IR observations (0.3-2.9 micrometres), not an sRGB colour texture.

runtime.derivation: Lanczos-resampled from the 32-bit floating-point 2880 x 1440 USGS GeoTIFF and encoded over the physical 0..1 range.

products.bindingNote: Retained for a future analytical/physical albedo layer. Binding this grayscale measurement as the current sRGB appearance channel would make Mars falsely grey.

intentionallyUnavailable.normal: Derive later from measured elevation with a recorded tangent-space convention.
intentionallyUnavailable.roughness: No defensible global PBR roughness source has been selected; use a constant material value.
intentionallyUnavailable.clouds: Mars clouds and dust are time-dependent observations, not a timeless opacity plate.
intentionallyUnavailable.emissive: Mars has no canonical intrinsic visible-light emissive surface map.
intentionallyUnavailable.geologyAndNomenclature: Global geology and IAU place names belong in future queryable Atlas vector layers, not baked into the material texture.
